008package paint.shared.config;
009
010import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
011import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
012import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
013
014import java.io.IOException;
015import java.io.Reader;
016import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
017import java.nio.file.Path;
018import java.nio.file.Files;
019import java.util.ArrayList;
020import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
021import java.util.List;
022import java.util.Map;
023
024// +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
025// NOTE: All `.get(...)`, `.has(...)`, and `.getAsXxx(...)` methods refer to Gson's JsonObject / JsonElement API.
026// +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
027
028/**
029 * The {@code SweepConfig} class provides functionality for loading, parsing,
030 * and retrieving sweep-related configuration from a JSON file.
031 * The configuration is stored internally as a {@link JsonObject}, and methods
032 * are provided to access specific types of data.
033 *
034 * <p>Typical usage:
035 * <pre>
036 *   SweepConfig cfg = new SweepConfig("path/to/file.json");
037 *   Map&lt;String, List&lt;Number&gt;&gt; values = cfg.getActiveSweepValues("CategoryName");
038 * </pre>
039 *
040 * <p>Key behaviours:
041 * <ul>
042 *   <li>Loads JSON from a file path in constructor.</li>
043 *   <li>Processes a category section (if present) to find attributes flagged `true`.</li>
044 *   <li>For each enabled attribute, collects numeric values from its corresponding JSON object.</li>
045 *   <li>Returns an ordered map (in insertion order) of attribute → list of numbers.</li>
046 * </ul>
047 */
048public class SweepConfig {
049
050    private final JsonObject root;
051
052    /**
053     * Constructs a SweepConfig object by parsing a JSON configuration file.
054     * This constructor reads the specified file, parses its content as JSON,
055     * and initializes the configuration data.
056     *
057     * @param filePath the path to the JSON file containing the sweep configuration.
058     * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs while reading the file.
059     */
060    public SweepConfig(String filePath) throws IOException {
061        try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(Path.of(filePath), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
062            JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseReader(reader);
063            if (!parsed.isJsonObject()) {
064                throw new IOException("Sweep configuration is not a JSON object: " + filePath);
065            }
066            this.root = parsed.getAsJsonObject();
067        }
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Retrieves the active sweep values for a specified category.
072     * <p>
073     * This method processes the JSON configuration to extract and return
074     * a map containing the category attributes and their corresponding
075     * active numeric values. Only enabled attributes (true) in the category
076     * section are included.
077     *
078     * @param category the name of the category whose sweep values are to be fetched.
079     *                 It corresponds to a key in the root JSON object.
080     * @return a map of attributes to lists of numeric values. The map is empty
081     * if the category does not exist or no active values are found.
082     */
083    public Map<String, List<Number>> getActiveSweepValues(String category) {
084        Map<String, List<Number>> activeValues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
085
086        JsonObject sweep = (root.has(category) && root.get(category).isJsonObject())
087                ? root.getAsJsonObject(category)
088                : null;
089        if (sweep == null) {
090            System.out.println("Sweep Section '" + category + "' not found");
091            return activeValues;
092        }
093
094        for (Map.Entry<String, JsonElement> entry : sweep.entrySet()) {
095            String      attribute = entry.getKey();
096            JsonElement flag      = entry.getValue();
097            // A malformed (non-boolean) flag disables that one attribute rather
098            // than throwing and aborting the whole sweep read.
099            boolean     enabled   = flag.isJsonPrimitive()
100                    && flag.getAsJsonPrimitive().isBoolean()
101                    && flag.getAsBoolean();
102
103            if (enabled && root.has(attribute) && root.get(attribute).isJsonObject()) {
104                JsonObject section = root.getAsJsonObject(attribute);
105                List<Number> values = new ArrayList<>();
106
107                for (Map.Entry<String, JsonElement> valEntry : section.entrySet()) {
108                    JsonElement val = valEntry.getValue();
109                    if (val.isJsonPrimitive() && val.getAsJsonPrimitive().isNumber()) {
110                        Number num = val.getAsNumber();
111                        // Keep as Integer if it has no decimal part
112                        if (num.doubleValue() == num.intValue()) {
113                            values.add(num.intValue());
114                        } else {
115                            values.add(num.doubleValue());
116                        }
117                    }
118                }
119                activeValues.put(attribute, values);
120            }
121        }
122        return activeValues;
123    }
124}
